name: sdlc
description: SDLC pipeline for Claude Code, architecture → ship (gitboolean fork): 16 skills — an architecture-to-ship backbone (map-architecture, architecture-design, complete-sequence-diagrams, generate-data-model, api-forge, break-tasks, plan-tests, implement-tasks, review-feature, ship-feature), scaffold from base-tpl, and utilities (classify-size, decide-adr, roadmap, prepare-design-spec, verify-ui, user-documentation). Ideation and PRD stages (interview, write-prd, clarify-prd, fix-term) live in the my-toolkit plugin of this marketplace — install both.
